name: Can I repair my sliding door screen myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair my sliding door screen myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can perform minor repairs like patching small holes with a screen repair kit. However, for larger tears, mesh replacement, or frame issues, professional repair is recommended. Professionals have the right tools and expertise to ensure a tight, even screen tension, proper spline installation, and correct frame alignment. Improper DIY repairs can lead to an ill-fitting screen, reduced durability, or further damage to the frame. We ensure a high-quality, lasting repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs can be DIY, but for larger tears or frame issues, professional repair is best to ensure proper installation and durability.
